descriptions.text: Enchanted Anarchist's Battle Rattle. This sleeveless jacket in its current form only offers meager protections compared to some other items of this caliber. However, its ability to host as many upgrade patches as you can fit makes this one of the best, most upgradeable protection items in the game. The plain, unadorned version of this jacket imbues the following effects: +1 to all base stats. This base stat upgrade increases by +1 for every compatible patch that is added to this jacket. If an eligible Back Patch is added, this benefit is doubled. Access to the Desperado Club (already obtained) Access to the Naughty Boys Employment Agency (already obtained) +50% range and accuracy for all thrown explosives.

beats.headline: A jacket of upgrade slots
beats.text: Carl's hands are shaking as the last box opens, the platinum Spicy Box. First out is a black, sleeveless jacket of thick canvas, glowing with a very subtle, almost purple light. You got really good loot this time, says Mordecai: the dungeon is starting to solidify your look for you. That's a patch jacket, with lots of upgrade slots, and they will need more patches as soon as possible. Carl is glad to be rid of his old leather jacket, burned, holed, one arm gone, its zipper broken two floors ago. He reads the new one's description. Hell yeah: the range benefit alone makes it one of his most valuable items.

beats.headline: Katia sews on two
beats.text: Two patches in one sitting. The gold ranged weapon box gives a small square of flaming arrows in an eagle claw, and the Gold Spicy Box a bigger white rectangle with a bomb hand-stitched in fine black thread, which Donut calls classic Spanish blackwork. Each patch adds a point to all Carl's stats on top of its own benefit; bigger ones take more room for the same. Katia, who affixed his first one, has already grabbed the sewing kit. Carl pulls off the jacket and hands it to her, and she maps out the best places and sews the arrows next to the planet earth on the shoulder, then moves to the bomb, placing it at the bottom left of the front along the hemline.

beats.headline: A back patch of skulls
beats.text: The celestial predator box explodes into fireflies and leaves only a full-sized back patch: thick black fabric embroidered with a white pyramid of skulls, covered in clear stitching like fiberoptic wire. Carl has five patches already, the earth, the arrows, the bomb, the anti-vampire Midnight Epicure patch and a new peace symbol, and a back patch doubles the boost they give. What it does itself stays hidden until it is affixed and worn. He sews it on himself, Donut on his shoulder disapproving of every stitch. The angle of entry is crucial!

beats.headline: A four-leaf clover patch
beats.text: Carl removes his jacket, grabs the sewing kit and sews on a small patch of a foot crushing down a set of four-leaf clovers, placing it above the Midnight Epicure patch. It gives the Lucky Shot benefit: once per floor, a fatal blow is deflected into the body of a party member instead. Then Donut wants to show him an upgrade for Mongo's saddle, and notices what he is doing: it is not straight. It is, says Carl, and he is taking the patch off the second he has used it.
